name: Bonito de Santa Fé (Brazil)
description: Light blue field charged with a green triangle bordered in white bearing a yellow triangle of the same base but lower height.
history: Bonito de Santa Fé is a municipality in the state of Paraíba, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the municipal constitution of 5 April 1990 lists the flag, anthem and arms as symbols to be prescribed by a separate law, and that photographs show darker shades than the drawing.

features.role: lower yellow triangle within the green
